title: Optimize index row id collection preallocation
constraints: Preserve BTree, FTS, LIKE, and trigram index scan semantics
rationale: Index scan paths often collect row ids from already materialized candidate lists. Preallocating HashSet capacity from those candidate counts reduces rehash and allocation churn without changing row id extraction or filtering semantics.
steps: Preallocate BTree equality row id set from index entry count
Preallocate FTS token row id sets from token posting counts
Reserve LIKE prefix row id set capacity from scanned candidate counts
Preallocate trigram row key set from row key count
Verify BTree index, FTS, parameterized MATCH, and LIKE behavior
expected_impact: Reduces allocation churn when index-backed scans collect row ids from candidate lists.
